digest.component_or_area: opcert_service app lifecycle and test harness
propositions: pytest-xdist worker crashes non-deterministically on test_opcert_service_app when TestClient fixture tears down because default executor threads are not disposed before the loop closes
asyncio.to_thread exposes no handle to the underlying OS thread, so teardown cannot deterministically clean up threads before the worker process exits
The fix must use an app-owned ThreadPoolExecutor with bounded, non-blocking shutdown (wait=False, cancel_futures=True) to remain consistent with ADR-0067's rejection of unbounded joins
Replacing asyncio.to_thread with loop.run_in_executor pointing to app.state.executor, and disposing it in lifespan finally before loop closure, moves thread lifecycle under deterministic app control
